agency.name: South Carolina State Housing Finance and Development Authority

official_page_findings.description: The official program page identifies the 2026 QAP as revised March 31, 2026 and separately links a signed certification of approval.
The official page labels the 2027 QAP and appendices as drafts; they cannot replace the adopted 2026 materials.
SC Housing publishes separate LIHTC, federal/state, and multiple-program manuals revised February 12, 2026 plus program-scoped tenant forms.
The page lists 2026 MTSP limits effective May 1, 2026 and HOME/NHTF limits effective June 1, 2026; each program and event date must remain separate.
SC Housing publishes separate 2026 Upstate, Midlands, and Low Country schedules and conditions Green Discount use on property certification.

blocking_conflicts.description: Official exact links and observed page counts are recorded, but byte lengths and SHA-256 identities have not been captured and no source may be activated.
The current 2026 operative authority must bind the signed approval, base QAP, March 31 amendment compilation, applicable appendices, bulletins and award cycle without substituting 2027 drafts.
LIHTC, federal/state and multiple-program manuals require page-cited reconciliation so one program cannot silently replace another.
Tenant, asset and student forms are labeled effective October 1, 2024 while guidance was revised in 2026; applicability and later notices require validation.
MTSP, HOME, NHTF and SC HTF figures have distinct sources and effective dates and must be selected from validated property geography, household, election and event facts.
Region, building type, tenant-paid utilities, allowable method, Green Discount qualification, evidence and effective date are property-specific and cannot be inferred from a generic statewide figure.
The published annual owner certification is scoped to HOME, SCHTF and NHTF and cannot be treated as a universal LIHTC annual certification.

enterprise_boundary: Only exact blank official forms and adopted public guidance belong in this shared pack. Completed tenant certifications, owner submissions, Forms 8609, reservation and carryover documents, extended-use agreements, utility schedules, waivers, approvals and inspection records remain enterprise/property records.
